title: Status screen
description: The status screen (C / top face button) fits on one screen: Estado with portrait, stats, ánima, a vague line about the day and the time; L / R (Q / E) turn to Ánimas (each member wears their own), Objetos (shared with Aitor), Mapa and Diario (a cryptic thought, never an instruction). With a second player on Aitor each opens their own half: Gerard left, Aitor right. Two standard gamepads are faked in the page.

steps.caption: Estado (C): portrait, the vitals plate with its two waves, the ánima switch, stats and skills, a vague line about the day and the time
E (or R on a controller) turns the page: Ánimas, each member's vitals with their own ánima chips, and what the ánima changes
Aitor puts Noísta on too: his face lights up in the ánima's colours
Objetos: one bag, shared with Aitor
Mapa: the flat with Gerard and Aitor on it
Diario: a thought he can't shake and what he remembers, chapter 1 folded into one line

steps.eval: window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0), fakePad(1)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads; window.frames = n => new Promise(done => { const tick = () => n-- > 0 ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : done(); tick(); }); window.tap = async (pad, button) => { window.fakePads[pad].buttons[button].pressed = true; await frames(4); window.fakePads[pad].buttons[button].pressed = false; await frames(4); };

steps.caption: Two players: Aitor's Y opens his half on the right; Gerard's side stays the world
Gerard's Y opens his half on the left: each sees their own Estado
Each turns their own pages: Gerard's L twice to Diario (past Cómo jugar), Aitor's R twice to Objetos
Aitor's own Ánimas page, driven by his controller: his vitals and his ánima only
Chapter 1: Gerard as a boy with his shoes and backpack, Bernat at a glance; no ánimas yet, so no Ánimas page
Chapter 1 Diario: what happened this morning and a thought about it
